map.ESSDAI(EULAR Sjögren's Syndrome Disease: ESSDAI (EULAR Sjogren's Syndrome Disease Activity Index, 2010) assesses primary Sjogren's systemic activity. It divides manifestations into 12 domains:
map.全身、淋巴结、腺体、关节、皮肤、肺、肾、肌肉、外周神经、中枢神经、血液、生物标志: Systemic, lymph node, glandular, articular, skin, pulmonary, renal, muscular, peripheral nerve, central nerve, hematologic, biological.
map.每个域按严重度赋 0–2(部分域 0–3)分,评分越高活动度越强。: Each domain scores 0-2 (some 0-3) by severity; higher = more activity.
map.总分 = 各域得分之和: Total score = sum of domain scores
map.(范围 0–约 123)。判读:0 = 无活动;≥5 = 中–高活动,通常需免疫: (range 0-about 123). Interpretation: 0 = no activity; >=5 = moderate-high activity, usually needs immunosuppression; >=14 = high activity. For clinical assessment reference only; diagnosis and medication are decided by a rheumatologist.
map.原发性干燥综合征脏器受累活动度金标准评分，≥14 提示高活动度。: Gold-standard score for primary Sjogren's organ involvement activity; >=14 suggests high activity.
map.EULAR Sjögren's Syndrome Disease Activit: EULAR Sjogren's Syndrome Disease Activity Index, assesses primary Sjogren's (pSS) organ involvement activity
map.请为以下12个域选择活动度级别：: Please select an activity level for the following 12 domains:
map.各系统 0 分 → 无系统活动，以口眼干对症为主并淋巴瘤筛查。: All systems 0 -> no systemic activity, mainly symptomatic for dry mouth/eyes plus lymphoma screening.
map.ESSDAI 评价系统性脏器活动，不反映口干眼干症状（症状用 ESSPRI）。: ESSDAI evaluates systemic organ activity, not dry mouth/eye symptoms (symptoms use ESSPRI).

map.干燥综合征ESSDAI系统活动度评估器，通过12个受累脏器域(全身、淋巴结、腺体: Sjogren's ESSDAI systemic activity assessor, weighted scoring via 12 involved organ domains (constitutional, lymph node, glandular, articular, skin, pulmonary, renal, muscular, nerve, hematologic, biological). A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.

map.中 — 中度/重度腺体肿大（本域最高档）: Moderate - moderate/severe gland enlargement (max level in this domain)
map.中 — 高球蛋白/低补体/冷球蛋白（本域最高档）: Moderate - hyperglobulinemia/low complement/cryoglobulinemia (max level in this domain)

map.12 域分级：腺体低(权重2×1=2)+关节中(2×2=4)+皮肤低(3×1=3: 12-domain grading: glandular low (weight 2 x1 = 2) + articular moderate (2 x2 = 4) + skin low (3 x1 = 3) + hematologic low (2 x1 = 2) + biological low (1 x1 = 1) -> total 12, moderate activity, needs moderate-dose steroid plus immunosuppressant.
